phaseprop.units.to_si¶

phaseprop.units.to_si(value: float, unit: str) → float¶

Convert input value to corresponding SI value.

Parameters:

  • value – Input value to be converted to corresponding SI value.

  • unit – Unit of input value.

Returns:

Value converted to corresponding SI unit.

Return type:

float

Raises:

ValueError – If the unit is not defined.
